verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and the CDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for any AWS tool. The CLI 'aws history' feature is local command history, not a telemetry control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
